brief: Goldman Prime reports hedge fund performance in the Nov 20 AI/tech sell-off, broken out by strategy type and region. Fundamental long/short managers fell 1.2% (-1.8 SD) on the day, with roughly 75% of funds down, driven by beta losses. Fund alpha was positive at +0.3%, led by the size factor and health care. Fundamental managers are down 2.1% month-to-date but remain up 7.0% year-to-date. US-focused funds fell 1.6% (-2.6 SD) on the day, and are down 2.9% MTD and up 3.6% YTD. Europe-focused funds fell 1.3% (-2.3 SD), down 2.3% MTD and up 5.4% YTD. Systematic long/short managers were flat on average, with wide dispersion across funds and 60% finishing lower. The systematic index is up 1.5% MTD and 17.7% YTD. The note reports performance data as of the Nov 20 US close and does not argue a thesis.
